title: Reading Practice Test 16 – Arts & Culture
description: Đề luyện Reading theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 28 câu: Part 5 (10) · Part 6 (4, có câu điền cả câu) · Part 7 (14: thông tin bảo tàng, thư cảm ơn nhà tài trợ, bài báo có chèn câu, ba đoạn liên kết). Chủ đề: bảo tàng, nhà hát, hoà nhạc, nghệ thuật cộng đồng.

questions.content: The museum's new exhibition features paintings by ------- artists from across Asia.
questions.explanation: Tính từ bổ nghĩa cho danh từ 'artists' → 'talented' (tài năng).

questions.content: Tickets for the opening night of the play sold out ------- a few hours.
questions.explanation: 'in + khoảng thời gian' = trong vòng (a few hours).

questions.content: The orchestra ------- in more than 30 countries since it was founded.
questions.explanation: 'since it was founded' → hiện tại hoàn thành 'has performed'.

questions.content: Visitors are not permitted to take photographs ------- the gallery.
questions.explanation: Vị trí (bên trong phòng trưng bày) → 'inside'. 'into/onto/toward' chỉ hướng chuyển động.

questions.content: The film festival attracts ------- 50,000 visitors every year.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho con số → 'approximately 50,000' (khoảng).

questions.content: The sculptor, ------- works are displayed in several museums, will give a talk on Friday.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống đứng trước danh từ 'works' và chỉ sở hữu (tác phẩm của nhà điêu khắc) → 'whose'.

questions.content: Please turn off all mobile phones ------- the performance begins.
questions.explanation: Tắt điện thoại 'trước khi' buổi diễn bắt đầu → 'before'. 'during' + danh từ; 'until' sai nghĩa.

questions.content: The concert was ------- by a sudden storm and had to be moved indoors.
questions.explanation: Bị động quá khứ 'was + V3' (bị gián đoạn bởi cơn bão) → 'interrupted'.

questions.content: The library's collection of rare books is ------- to researchers by appointment only.
questions.explanation: Sau 'is' cần tính từ: 'be available to' = sẵn có cho (ai).

questions.content: The director hopes the film will appeal to ------- young and older audiences.
questions.explanation: Cặp liên từ 'both … and' = cả … lẫn.

groups.passage:
The Lindale Theater Announces Its New Season

The Lindale Theater is pleased to announce its fall season, which will open on September 12 with a new production of the classic comedy The Wedding Plans. The play ---131--- by award-winning director Elena Rossi.

In October, the theater will host a series of concerts by local musicians. ---132---. The season will end in December with a holiday show for the whole family.

Season tickets, which include admission to all five productions, are now on sale at a 20% discount. ---133---, season ticket holders will receive free parking at the Main Street garage.

Tickets can be purchased at the box office or online. The box office is open Tuesday through Saturday ---134--- noon to 6:00 P.M.

questions.explanation: Vở kịch 'sẽ được đạo diễn bởi' (bị động, tương lai – mùa diễn chưa mở) → 'will be directed'.

options.A: The concerts will feature jazz, folk, and classical music.

questions.explanation: Câu trước giới thiệu chuỗi hoà nhạc tháng Mười → câu chèn mô tả các thể loại nhạc.
Câu sau bổ sung thêm quyền lợi (miễn phí gửi xe) → 'Moreover' (hơn nữa).
'from … to …' = từ … đến … (khung giờ).

groups.passage:
Harlow Art Museum – Visitor Information

The East Gallery will be closed from May 1 to May 20 for the installation of our summer exhibition, Light and Color: Impressionist Landscapes. All other galleries remain open.

Admission is free on the first Sunday of every month. Guided tours in English and Spanish are offered daily at 11:00 A.M. and 2:00 P.M.

Photography without flash is permitted in the permanent collection only.

questions.content: Why will the East Gallery be closed?

options.B: A new exhibition is being installed.
options.C: It is being used for a private event.

questions.explanation: '…closed from May 1 to May 20 for the installation of our summer exhibition.'

questions.content: What is indicated about the museum?

options.A: It offers free admission once a month.
options.C: It offers tours only in English.

questions.explanation: 'Admission is free on the first Sunday of every month.'

groups.passage:
Dear Mr. and Mrs. Tanaka,

On behalf of the Riverside Museum of History, thank you for your generous donation of $5,000 to our building fund. Your support will help us complete the new education wing, which will include three classrooms and a library for students and teachers.

As a token of our appreciation, your names will appear on the donor wall at the museum's main entrance. We would also like to invite you to a special preview of the new wing on November 3, before it opens to the public on November 10.

Please let us know by October 20 whether you will be able to attend. We look forward to seeing you.

Sincerely,
Helen Park
Director of Development

questions.content: Why did Ms. Park write the letter?

options.A: To express gratitude for a contribution

questions.explanation: Thư cảm ơn khoản quyên góp $5,000 và mời dự buổi xem trước.

questions.content: What will the new education wing include?
questions.explanation: '…will include three classrooms and a library for students and teachers.'

questions.content: When will the public be able to visit the new wing?
questions.explanation: '…before it opens to the public on November 10.' Ngày 3/11 chỉ dành cho buổi xem trước đặc biệt.

groups.passage:
Murals Bring Color to Downtown Walls

Over the past year, twelve large murals have appeared on buildings throughout downtown Carlton. The paintings are part of the city's Art on Main project, which aims to attract visitors and support local artists. [1]

Each mural was selected by a committee of artists, business owners, and residents. [2] The designs reflect the city's history, from its early days as a fishing village to its growth as a technology center.

The project has already had an impact. Businesses near the murals report increased foot traffic, and walking tours of the artwork are now offered every Saturday. [3] Because of this success, the city council has approved funding for eight more murals next year. [4]

questions.content: What is the purpose of the Art on Main project?

options.B: To draw visitors and help local artists

questions.explanation: '…aims to attract visitors and support local artists.'

questions.content: How were the murals chosen?

options.D: By a committee from the community

questions.explanation: 'Each mural was selected by a committee of artists, business owners, and residents.'

questions.content: The word "impact" in paragraph 3, line 1, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: 'had an impact' = có tác động → effect. 'crash' (va chạm) là nghĩa đen – bẫy.

questions.content:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"The committee reviewed more than 300 proposals before making its choices."
questions.explanation: 'The committee' chỉ hội đồng được nhắc ở câu ngay trước → vị trí [2].

groups.passage:
Summer Concerts at Bayfront Park
All concerts begin at 7:30 P.M. Gates open at 6:30 P.M.

June 14 – Harbor City Symphony: Film Music Favorites
June 28 – The Blue Notes: Jazz Classics
July 12 – Maria Santos: Latin Guitar
July 26 – Northern Lights Choir: Songs of the World

Tickets: Lawn seating $15 · Reserved seating $35
In case of rain, concerts will be held at the Civic Auditorium. Lawn tickets will be accepted for balcony seats.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Order Confirmation BF4471
Customer: Diane Porter
Concert: July 12
Tickets: 2 × Reserved seating
Total: $70
Tickets will be sent to your e-mail address one week before the concert.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: tickets@bayfrontconcerts.org
From: Diane Porter
Date: July 10
Subject: Order BF4471

Hello,

I purchased two tickets for this Saturday's concert, but I have not yet received them by e-mail. I checked my spam folder as well. Could you please resend them?

Also, the weather forecast for Saturday shows heavy rain. If the concert is moved indoors, will my seats be in the same section?

Thank you,
Diane Porter

questions.content: What is NOT stated about the concerts?

options.A: Food will be sold at the park.
options.B: Gates open an hour before each concert.
options.D: All concerts start at the same time.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi NOT: lịch không nhắc tới việc bán đồ ăn. Các ý còn lại đều có.

questions.content: Which performer will Ms. Porter most likely see?
questions.explanation: Đơn hàng cho buổi 12/7 – theo lịch là Maria Santos: Latin Guitar.

questions.content: Why did Ms. Porter write the e-mail?

options.D: To report that her tickets did not arrive

questions.explanation: 'I have not yet received them by e-mail… Could you please resend them?'

questions.content: What is suggested about Ms. Porter's order?

options.B: The tickets should have arrived by now.

questions.explanation: Vé được gửi một tuần trước buổi diễn (tức khoảng 5/7); ngày 10/7 cô vẫn chưa nhận → lẽ ra đã phải nhận.

questions.content: Where will the concert most likely take place if it rains?
questions.explanation: 'In case of rain, concerts will be held at the Civic Auditorium.'
